The '''''Hasty Harpy''''' was a [[YT-1760 small transport/Legends|YT-1760]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] owned by [[Lalo Gunn]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was grounded on [[Kynachi]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] along with all other ships on the planet, causing Gunn to be stranded there.

It was later recovered, and Gunn volunteered to take the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Breakout Squad]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. En route, they were contacted by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and asked to meet with a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] representative on [[Ifpe'a|Defense Force Station Ifpe'a]]. Fleeing a [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] attack, they were caught by a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]]. The ship later escaped using an ancient [[Star Temple]].

They were contacted again by Chancellor Palpatine and asked to [[Mission to Vaced|divert]] to [[Vaced/Legends|Vaced]]. On the planet, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Nuru Kungurama]] fought a [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], and the ''Hasty Harpy'' was hit by a missile launched from the assassin's [[Hudu Shiv's Pursuer-class enforcement ship|starship]] and crashed, forcing Gunn to stay on Vaced and search for a new ship.

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Hasty Harpy'' appears in [[Ryder Windham]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Secret Missions]]'' book series.
